title: steps/sessionEnd payload
description: Payload for the sessionEnd hook. Fires when the session terminates. Asynchronous; does not block agent.

summary.description: Optional summary written by the agent's framework

decision_failures.description: Decision failures the Observed Agent recorded in this session, counted per failure class (Specification 6.4). The classes are the acs.failure.class values in trace/otel-mapping.json. A class with no failures MAY be omitted or set to 0. A reader treats a session that ends without this object as unmeasurable.

final_chain_hash.description: Final SessionContext chain hash from the agent's perspective. Guardian SHOULD verify against its own chain.
